title: Tabsurvey 2.4 Release Notes
text:
Version 2.4 focuses on bulk actions and raw speed for people who hoard tabs. The update ships today for every supported browser.

Added: bulk actions for closing duplicate tabs.

Added: bulk group restore from the sessions page.

Changed: search now scans page text and returns results three times faster.

Fixed: a memory leak that grew during long idle hours.

Fixed: duplicated counters in the status bar.

Upgrade notes: settings migrate automatically and no restart is required. Rollback stays possible through the previous release channel.
reference: Version 2.4 brings bulk tab actions, three times faster search, and a memory leak fix.
